entries.back_en: "...Where are you going? Why was [04][05] left behind?"
entries.note: Source is active 'why are you leaving X behind'; target uses passive 'was X left behind', shifting agency/meaning.

entries.back_en: "Hee hee... Heh heh. I am saddened by the fact that you have left, [04][05]."
"Does this mean [04][05] no longer needs me?"
entries.note: Subject/object reversed: source 'you no longer need X', target 'X no longer needs me'.

entries.back_en: "I see. Hee hee hee hee! Ha ha ha ha ha! ... ... It would appear that was not the appropriate time to laugh."
"...What should I do to act like a suit of armor?"
"It's true! Everyone saw them coming and ran away before they reached the village... Everyone except... Except the Abbess!"
"Heh heh heh heh... Is this... the right time... to laugh? Heh heh... heh..."
"He tried to protect me... He fought with the soldiers... He used up all his energy trying to help me!"
"Why do you care? It's just armor. He wasn't alive from the beginning."
entries.note: 'se importa' (care) slightly softer than 'so upset about', but meaning preserved.

entries.back_en: "It doesn't matter if he's alive or not. He still fought to save me. He deserves to be honored--he may be a suit of armor, but he's more human than some!"
"The village was attacked by Imperial Troops."
"You fool... What were you trying to prove?"
